title: JapanesePod101 — ビジネス日本語の基本 (Fundamentals of Business Japanese)
description: From JapanesePod101. Covers practical business Japanese at the N3 level: making and receiving phone calls at work, writing formal emails, the difference between formal and casual register in the office, common business set phrases (お世話になっております、よろしくお願いいたします、お疲れ様でした), and how to politely decline or postpone.
